description: Create the complete Android project structure with Gradle build files, Android Manifest, and all configuration. This includes root build.gradle.kts, app module build.gradle.kts with all dependencies (Compose, Room, Firebase, Hilt, Retrofit for OpenAI API), settings.gradle.kts, gradle.properties, and the Gradle wrapper files.
steps: Create root build.gradle.kts with Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin plugin declarations
Create settings.gradle.kts with repository configuration (google, mavenCentral, gradlePluginPortal) and app module include
Create gradle.properties with Android-specific properties (AndroidX, non-transitive R classes, JVM target)

Create app/build.gradle.kts with: compileSdk 34, minSdk 24, targetSdk 34, Compose compiler, dependencies for Jetpack Compose (BOM 2024.01.00), Room (2.6.1), Firebase (BOM 32.7.0 - Auth, Firestore, Storage), Hilt (2.50), Retrofit (2.9.0) for OpenAI API, Navigation Compose, Material3, Accompanist permissions, Media3/ExoPlayer for audio playback, Kotlin coroutines
Create app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml with permissions (INTERNET, RECORD_AUDIO, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and application/activity declarations
Create app/proguard-rules.pro with standard Android ProGuard rules
Create a gradle wrapper script (gradlew and gradlew.bat) shell scripts
acceptance_criteria: All Gradle build files exist and have correct Kotlin DSL syntax
AndroidManifest.xml declares the correct package, permissions, and main activity
All required dependencies are declared in app/build.gradle.kts
Project structure follows standard Android conventions
verification: Verify all build files exist: build.gradle.kts, app/build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts, gradle.properties
Check that app/build.gradle.kts contains compose, room, firebase, hilt, retrofit dependencies
